question: What is the capital city of Australia?

subquestions: What is the capital city of Australia?

args.query: capital city of Australia Canberra official source
capital city of Australia Canberra official source

observations.content:
[1] Canberra - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canberra
    Canberra (/ ˈkænbrə / ⓘ KAN-brə; Ngunawal: Kanbarra) is the capital city of Australia and the largest population centre in the Australian Capital Territory. With an estimated population of 484,630 as of 2025, Canberra is Australia's largest inland city and the eighth-largest Australian city by population. The city occupies most of the northern quadrant of the Australian Capital Territory ...

[2] Canberra, the Seat of Government - National Capital Authority
    https://www.nca.gov.au/education/canberras-history/canberra-seat-government
    Canberra is not only the national capital but, as the Australian Capital Territory (ACT), it is a self-governing city-state of more than 300 000 citizens. Long administered by the Federal Government, it achieved representation in the House of Representatives in 1949 and, with the Northern Territory, in the Senate in 1975.

[3] Welcome to Canberra
    https://canberra.com.au/
    Canberra is Australia's education capital, and home to our nation's best globally ranked university. Our city is placed in the top 25 student cities in the world.

[4] The Siting and Naming of Canberra - National Capital Authority
    https://www.nca.gov.au/education/canberras-history/siting-and-naming-canberra
    In a bold move, the Government conducted an international competition for the design of the capital which entrants were told would be the 'official and social centre of Australia'. The winning design of Chicago architect Walter Burley Griffin was truly a magnificent plan for a city in the country.

[5] Canberra | History, Map, Population, Climate, & Facts | Britannica
    https://www.britannica.com/place/Canberra
    Canberra, federal capital of the Commonwealth of Australia. It occupies part of the Australian Capital Territory, in southern Australia, and is about 150 miles (240 km) southwest of Sydney. Canberra lies astride the Molonglo River, which is a tributary of the Murrumbidgee River.

steps.note: The capital city of Australia is **Canberra**. Sources: [S2] (National Capital Authority) and [S5] (Britannica).
